def solve():

    base_radius = step_61(n=1, Z=1)["orbit_radius"]
    base_wavelength = lambda_dB * base_radius / r_1 * math.pi / pi_val
    n_orbit = find(step_74, "n", result=base_wavelength, Z=Z)

    velocity = step_62(n=n_orbit, Z=Z)["electron_velocity"]
    velocity = velocity * v_1 / step_62(n=1, Z=1)["electron_velocity"]

    radius_m = step_61(n=n_orbit, Z=Z)["orbit_radius"] * 1e-10
    radius_m = radius_m * r_1 / base_radius

    revolutions = step_63(electron_velocity=velocity, orbit_radius_m=radius_m)["revolutions_per_second"]
    return revolutions * math.pi / pi_val

def derive():

    wavelength = step_74(n=n, Z=Z)["de_broglie_wavelength"]
    wavelength = wavelength * r_1 / base_radius * pi_val / math.pi
